title: Election Night Bingo
shareText: Got my Election Night Bingo card. Grab yours, it's free:
bingoText: BINGO on election night! Get your own free card:
_rules: Non-partisan, per fat-city-entertainment ELECTION-PLAN.md: broadcast moments only. No candidate, party or officeholder names, nothing that depends on who wins, no voting logistics. Navy/cream/gold, never one party's colour.
